retrievalProfile.description: A central surrealist photographic subject flanked by vertical columns of square-format graphic icons and industrial textures.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central vertical rectangle containing a desaturated, grainy photograph of a hand holding a circular emblem, bordered on the left and right by vertical strips of small square tiles featuring industrial patterns, primary color blocks, and abstract symbols.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between left and right icon columns
Contrast between the smooth skin of the hand and the gritty industrial textures in the tiles
Centralized focus on a circular focal point held by fingers
Balanced distribution of primary color accents (red, yellow, blue) within the monochrome grid
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain or halftone texture across all photographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central vertical panel containing a hand, scaled to occupy 60% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular emblem held between the thumb and forefinger.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down reading of the title, followed by a vertical scan of the side columns, converging on the central hand.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white margins at the top and bottom for text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and muted skin tones in the central image.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: High-contrast black and white industrial textures in the side tiles.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Solid primary blocks of red, yellow, and cyan blue.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in photographic elements contrasted with high-saturation geometric color blocks.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to greyscale, primary accents, and one muted mid-tone for the subject.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Bold weight for title, medium weight for subtitle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Vertical grid of 1:1 aspect ratio squares
Thin black borders around the central image

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and circular counters.
Captures the tight tracking and geometric construction perfectly.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a central vertical panel with a grainy, desaturated photo of a hand holding a disc. Flank it with two vertical columns of 8 square tiles each, containing industrial textures, abstract symbols, and solid primary color blocks. Leave wide white margins at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered geometric sans-serif text in the top and bottom white margins using a bold weight for the top and medium weight for the bottom.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly two vertical columns of square icons?
Is the central image desaturated and grainy?
Are there solid red, yellow, and blue squares in the grid?
Is the typography centered in the white margins?

adjustableVariables: Number of tiles in side columns
Specific industrial textures (e.g., wire, concrete, metal)
Saturation level of the central subject
mustRedesign: Specific logos or brand-identifying symbols in the tiles
The exact graphic on the held disc
Any specific artist signatures or legal text

mustAchieve: Visible film grain or halftone screen
avoid: Overlapping the text with the image

postGenerationChecks: Check for 1:1 aspect ratio in the side tiles
Verify the presence of a grainy texture overlay
Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally
Confirm the primary color blocks are solid and untextured
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject [Subject] + Vertical grid borders [Textures/Colors] + Geometric Sans-Serif [Title] = Industrial Surrealist Layout
